name: RecyclingFabrik (Recycling Fabrik GmbH)
summary: Braunschweig, Germany recycler founded in April 2021 that turns 3D-print waste and industrial scrap into recycled PLA and PETG filament, and runs a take-back service. Offers custom RAL colours on spools from 0.75 kg to 10 kg; in April 2026 it paused customer intake to develop a next-generation process.

product_lines.name: rPLA
product_lines.notes: Recycled from 3D-print waste and industrial scrap; custom RAL colours.

additional_notes: Managing directors Rudolf Leue and Joern van Leeuwen. Does its own recycling and extrusion; no white-label relationship was found, so oem_relationships is empty. Sold through 3DJake, which has a RecyclingFabrik brand page; that is a retail listing only. Spool sizes 0.75-10 kg per the Formnext exhibitor profile. Fabbaloo (April 2026) reported that intake was paused to develop a next-generation process, so check current availability. Price tier not verified, so omitted. PDF flyers are on the company site.

provenance.conflicts: Notes rate this medium-high. Current operating status after the 2026 intake pause is unclear.
